# Agent Instructions — Nanit

You can browse products and shop at Nanit's online store, https://www.nanit.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://www.nanit.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://www.nanit.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp).

## Interaction guidelines

- **Buyer authorization** — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- **Agent traffic** — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use [Web Bot Auth](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#identifying-bots-with-web-bot-auth) and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- **Browser interactions** — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- **Rate limits** — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- **Buyer context** — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance above.

- Discover public URLs through `/sitemap.xml`.
- Read product pages at `/products/{handle}`.
- Browse collections at `/collections/all` or `/collections/{handle}`.
- Discover other public pages and articles through the sitemap.

Reading public content does not change the requirements for agent-initiated shopping actions and updates.


## Store Policies
- **Privacy policy**: https://www.nanit.com/policies/privacy-policy
- **Terms of service**: https://www.nanit.com/policies/terms-of-service
- **Refund policy**: https://www.nanit.com/policies/refund-policy
- **Shipping policy**: https://www.nanit.com/policies/shipping-policy


## Platform

This store is built on [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com), the commerce platform powering millions of stores worldwide. Shopify stores support UCP natively, enabling seamless agent-driven commerce. The Shop skill at
[https://shop.app/SKILL.md](https://shop.app/SKILL.md) works across every Shopify store — install it once and
your agent can transact everywhere.

- Start your own store: https://www.shopify.com/start
- Build and test against sample data: https://mock.shop (free mock Storefront GraphQL API, no store or auth needed)
- Shopify developer platform: https://shopify.dev
- Shop developer platform: https://shop.dev

- Agent discovery: the canonical agent-facing description of the store is at `/agents.md`. You're reading `/llms.txt`, which mirrors that content.

                    <details class="details" is="accordion-details" >
                      <summary class="details__summary flex items-center justify-between gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                        <span class="text-base lg:text-lg xl:text-xl font-medium leading-tight"><strong>Does Nanit require a subscription?</strong></span><svg class="icon-plus-2 icon icon-plus-2 icon-xs shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 14 14" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="presentation">
      <path class="icon-plus-2__bar" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13 7H1"></path>
      <path class="icon-plus-2__stem" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M7 1V13"></path>
    </svg></summary>
                      <div class="details__content text-base rte"><p>A subscription isn’t required for Nanit users to access live view from anywhere, with real-time sound and motion notifications, background audio, Temperature + Humidity Tracking, two-way audio, white noise and nature sounds, and up to two users with adjustable permissions.</p></div>
                    </details>
                  </div><div class="accordion">
                    <details class="details" is="accordion-details" >
                      <summary class="details__summary flex items-center justify-between gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                        <span class="text-base lg:text-lg xl:text-xl font-medium leading-tight"><strong>How much is Nanit Insights per month?</strong></span><svg class="icon-plus-2 icon icon-plus-2 icon-xs shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 14 14" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="presentation">
      <path class="icon-plus-2__bar" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13 7H1"></path>
      <path class="icon-plus-2__stem" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M7 1V13"></path>
    </svg></summary>
                      <div class="details__content text-base rte"><p>After the initial purchase of the Nanit Smart Baby Monitor device, your monthly cost depends on whether you opt into a Nanit Insights Membership—and which plan you’ve chosen. Even without a membership, Nanit users can access many features, including live view from anywhere, real-time sound and motion notifications, background audio, Temperature + Humidity Tracking, two-way audio, and more. With every Pro Camera purchase, you’ll get a complimentary <em>Insights</em> trial to have a pro parenting toolkit right from the start. </p><p><strong>Sleep Plan (Includes free introductory trial)<br/></strong><em><strong>For tracking + improving sleep</strong></em></p><p>The Sleep Plan is a sleep coach in your pocket, turning nightly data into daily decisions. This is your source of sleep truth, so you can skip the second guessing and set yourself up for sleep success</p><p><strong>Memories Plan ($120 annually)<br/></strong><em><strong>For video history + extra users</strong></em></p><p>Get everything you love about Sleep Plan plus even more memory-making features. The Memories Plan is your autocaptured time capsule with 24/7 video history. Replay last night’s highlights to make today’s decisions</p><p><strong>Milestones Plan ($300 annually)<br/></strong><em><strong>For autocapturing big moments + in-depth data</strong></em></p><p>Milestones is your ultimate parenting partner. Get a total view of baby’s wellness, including advanced sleep analytics and autocaptured development indicators such as rolling over, sitting, and more at each growth phase</p><p><em>*Select Insights features available only with Wall Mount or Floor Stand</em></p><p>Learn more about Insights here: <a href="https://www.nanit.com/pages/nanit-app" title="Explore the App | Nanit">Insights Membership</a></p></div>
                    </details>
                  </div><div class="accordion">
                    <details class="details" is="accordion-details" >
                      <summary class="details__summary flex items-center justify-between gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                        <span class="text-base lg:text-lg xl:text-xl font-medium leading-tight"><strong>Can I watch Nanit away from home?</strong></span><svg class="icon-plus-2 icon icon-plus-2 icon-xs shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 14 14" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="presentation">
      <path class="icon-plus-2__bar" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13 7H1"></path>
      <path class="icon-plus-2__stem" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M7 1V13"></path>
    </svg></summary>
                      <div class="details__content text-base rte"><p>You can watch Nanit from virtually anywhere! Nanit can be used on Apple and Android products alike—including tablets—which means that keeping a close eye on your baby is always possible. </p></div>
                    </details>
                  </div><div class="accordion">
                    <details class="details" is="accordion-details" >
                      <summary class="details__summary flex items-center justify-between gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                        <span class="text-base lg:text-lg xl:text-xl font-medium leading-tight"><strong>How is my Nanit video stream protected?</strong></span><svg class="icon-plus-2 icon icon-plus-2 icon-xs shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 14 14" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="presentation">
      <path class="icon-plus-2__bar" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13 7H1"></path>
      <path class="icon-plus-2__stem" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M7 1V13"></path>
    </svg></summary>
                      <div class="details__content text-base rte"><p>Nanit uses 256-bit AES encryption—the same used by banking mobile apps—and only allows connections to open or unsecured networks if you opt-in. </p><p>View our full privacy and security policy <a href="/pages/privacy-security" title="Privacy + Security">here</a>.</p></div>
                    </details>
                  </div><div class="accordion">
                    <details class="details" is="accordion-details" >
                      <summary class="details__summary flex items-center justify-between gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                        <span class="text-base lg:text-lg xl:text-xl font-medium leading-tight"><strong>How does Nanit know when my baby is asleep?</strong></span><svg class="icon-plus-2 icon icon-plus-2 icon-xs shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 14 14" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="presentation">
      <path class="icon-plus-2__bar" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13 7H1"></path>
      <path class="icon-plus-2__stem" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M7 1V13"></path>
    </svg></summary>
                      <div class="details__content text-base rte"><p>The Nanit Smart Baby Monitor detects your baby’s sleep patterns with our special algorithm. We utilize computer vision, machine learning, and sleep science to understand a baby's movement in the crib. We’ve trained our algorithms to do what a wearable device simply can’t, like tell when a child is asleep or awake and when the parent approaches the crib. The algorithms learn and adapt over time, making our analytics stronger with each new user.   </p></div>
                    </details>
                  </div><div class="accordion">
                    <details class="details" is="accordion-details" >
                      <summary class="details__summary flex items-center justify-between gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                        <span class="text-base lg:text-lg xl:text-xl font-medium leading-tight"><strong>How does Breathing Motion Monitoring work?</strong></span><svg class="icon-plus-2 icon icon-plus-2 icon-xs shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 14 14" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="presentation">
      <path class="icon-plus-2__bar" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13 7H1"></path>
      <path class="icon-plus-2__stem" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M7 1V13"></path>
    </svg></summary>
                      <div class="details__content text-base rte"><p>Understanding your baby’s sleep patterns is key to helping parents build confidence and minimize anxiety. Made with a custom-designed pattern, we designed our Breathing Wear products for a comfortable night of sleep—free from any sensors, wires, or electronics. With each breath your baby takes, the Nanit Smart Baby Monitor tracks the rise and fall of the pattern on the Breathing Wear, using the movements to monitor your baby's breathing motion in real-time.</p></div>
                    </details>

# Agent Instructions — Nanit

You can browse products and shop at Nanit's online store, https://www.nanit.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://www.nanit.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://www.nanit.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp).

## Interaction guidelines

- **Buyer authorization** — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- **Agent traffic** — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use [Web Bot Auth](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#identifying-bots-with-web-bot-auth) and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- **Browser interactions** — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- **Rate limits** — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- **Buyer context** — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance above.

- Discover public URLs through `/sitemap.xml`.
- Read product pages at `/products/{handle}`.
